events.name: Georgia Bulldogs at South Carolina Gamecocks

headlines.description: — Georgia has been to the Southeastern Championship game so often, coach Kirby Smart didn't even know he'll make history with his latest appearance — his sixth in a row.
headlines.shortLinkText: Frazier's two TDs lift No. 1 Georgia into SEC title game with 34-6 win at South Carolina

events.name: Utah Utes at TCU Horned Frogs

headlines.description: — Devon Dampier threw a 68-yard touchdown pass before halftime and an 85-yard clincher in the fourth quarter as No. 2 Utah beat TCU 38-17 on Saturday night for its 17th straight victory, clinching a spot in the Big 12 championship game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dampier throws 2 long TD passes as No. 2 Utah beats TCU 38-17 to clinch spot in Big 12 title game

events.name: Chattanooga Mocs at Alabama Crimson Tide

headlines.description: — Austin Mack threw for 254 yards and four touchdowns, leading No. 7 Alabama past Chattanooga 47-0 on Saturday in its final tuneup before the Iron Bowl.
headlines.shortLinkText: Austin Mack throws 4 TD passes as No. 7 Alabama beats Chattanooga 47-0

events.name: UCLA Bruins at Michigan Wolverines

headlines.description: — No. 4 UCLA won its first 10 games of the season by taking care of the football and forcing turnovers. Now it is 10-1.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bryce Underwood lifts Michigan to an 18-16 win over No. 4 UCLA in 3 overtimes

events.name: Arkansas Razorbacks at Texas Longhorns

headlines.description: — Arch Manning threw for two touchdowns and ran for a score, helping No. 8 Texas beat Arkansas 45-3 on Saturday for the Longhorns' fifth consecutive win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arch Manning accounts for 3 TDs, and No. 8 Texas beats Arkansas 45-3 for its 5th straight win

events.name: SMU Mustangs at Notre Dame Fighting Irish

headlines.description: — Notre Dame’s defense held SMU to its lowest point total since 2016, and the No. 3 Fighting Irish ground out a 24-3 victory on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Defense powers No. 3 Notre Dame past SMU 24-3

events.name: Virginia Tech Hokies at Miami Hurricanes

headlines.description: — Mark Fletcher Jr. has never played in an Atlantic Coast Conference championship game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fletcher's 3 TD runs lift No. 5 Miami past Virginia Tech 28-20, 'Canes clinch spot in ACC title game

events.name: Indiana Hoosiers at Washington Huskies

headlines.description: — Not only is No. 6 Indiana’s quest to defend its national title in peril, the Hoosiers might not even get a chance to defend their Big Ten crown.
headlines.shortLinkText: No. 6 Indiana loses 27-24 in overtime at Washington and might fall out of playoff picture

events.name: LSU Tigers at Tennessee Volunteers

headlines.description: — Faizon Brandon had two long touchdown runs in the fourth quarter, Tennessee's stifling defense shut down LSU late, and the No. 9 Volunteers beat the Tigers 27-13 on Saturday to maintain their place in the College Football Playoff hunt.
headlines.shortLinkText: Faizon Brandon runs for 2 fourth-quarter TDs, No. 9 Tennessee beats LSU 27-13 at Neyland Stadium

events.name: BYU Cougars at Kansas Jayhawks

headlines.description: — Bear Bachmeier threw for 173 yards, ran for a pair of touchdowns and connected with Jojo Phillips in the back of the end zone in the third overtime, helping No. 12 BYU beat Kansas 31-29 on Saturday and keep its College Football Playoff hopes alive.
headlines.shortLinkText: No. 12 BYU beats Kansas 31-29 in 3 overtimes to stay alive in the College Football Playoff race

events.name: Wake Forest Demon Deacons at Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets

headlines.description: — Gio Lopez completed 17 of 22 passes for 324 yards and accounted for four total touchdowns as No. 10 Wake Forest beat Georgia Tech 50-29 on Saturday afternoon.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gio Lopez rushes for two scores and throws two more as Wake Forest beats Georgia Tech 50-29

events.name: Texas Tech Red Raiders at Baylor Bears

headlines.description: — Malcolm Simmons had another big scoring play, Texas Tech's defense got four more sacks and the 11th-ranked Red Raiders moved closer to another Big 12 championship game.
headlines.shortLinkText: No. 11 Texas Tech moves closer to another Big 12 title game with 20-10 win at Baylor

events.name: Ohio State Buckeyes at Nebraska Cornhuskers

headlines.description: — A decade’s worth of pent-up frustration came pouring out after Nebraska went into victory formation, Anthony Colandrea took one last snap and kneeled, and thousands of fans came rushing onto the field to celebrate the end of one of the most...
headlines.shortLinkText: Nebraska ends 31-game losing streak against AP Top 25 opponents with 31-28 win over No. 16 Buckeyes

events.name: Iowa Hawkeyes at Illinois Fighting Illini

headlines.description: — L.J. Phillips Jr. ran for 154 yards and a touchdown, Iowa's stingy defense shut out Illinois in the second half, and the No. 13 Hawkeyes beat the Fighting Illini 34-17 on Saturday to give their College Football Playoff hopes a big boost.
headlines.shortLinkText: No. 13 Iowa shuts out Illinois in the second half, pulls away for 34-17 win to help playoff hopes

events.name: Kentucky Wildcats at Missouri Tigers

headlines.description: — Austin Simmons threw for 314 yards and four touchdowns, Donovan Olugbode caught five passes for 105 yards and two of the scores, and Missouri beat No. 17 Kentucky 28-14 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Austin Simmons throws 4 TD passes, leading Missouri past No. 17 Kentucky 28-14

events.name: San Diego State Aztecs at Boise State Broncos

headlines.description: — Cooper DiLeva kicked a 42-yard field goal as time expired as San Diego State scored nine points in the last two minutes to shock No. 15 Boise State 22-20 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cooper DiLeva kicks a field goal as time expires, San Diego State shocks No. 15 Boise State 22-20

events.name: Maryland Terrapins at USC Trojans

headlines.description: — Lincoln Riley was a bit more vocal than usual after No. 18 Southern California trudged into the Coliseum locker room amid scattered boos while trailing Maryland at halftime of the Trojans' home finale.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trent Mosley, Waymond Jordan score 2 TDs apiece in No. 18 USC's 35-21 win over Maryland

events.name: Arizona Wildcats at Kansas State Wildcats

headlines.description: — Noah Fifita hit Giovanni Richardson for a 25-yard touchdown pass in overtime, and No. 19 Arizona stopped Kansas State quarterback Dylan Duff on fourth down at the 3-yard line, preserving a 35-28 victory on a rain-soaked Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Noah Fifita rallies No. 19 Arizona through the rain to a 35-28 overtime win over Kansas State

events.name: Houston Cougars at West Virginia Mountaineers

headlines.description: — Keisean Henderson made the most of his first start for No. 20 Houston.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jonathan Dimas kicks 23-yard field goal to send No. 20 Houston past West Virginia 34-31

events.name: Texas A&M Aggies at Oklahoma Sooners

headlines.description: — John Mateer overcame a pair of early turnovers by passing for three touchdowns and running for another score, and the Oklahoma defense forced eight punts in a 28-7 win over Texas A&M on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mateer accounts for 4 touchdowns, Oklahoma smothers Texas A&M 28-7

events.name: Pittsburgh Panthers at Louisville Cardinals

headlines.description: — Lincoln Kienholz threw a season-high five touchdown passes and Louisville's defense forced four turnovers Saturday night as the 21st-ranked Cardinals rolled to a 42-10 victory over Pittsburgh.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lincoln Kienholz throws 5 TD passes and No. 21 Louisville forces 4 turnovers in 42-10 win over Pitt

events.name: Vanderbilt Commodores at Florida Gators

headlines.description: — Florida coach Jon Sumrall will take all the help he can get in his first season in Gainesville.
headlines.shortLinkText: No. 23 Florida takes advantage of a lucky bounce and beats Vanderbilt 34-27 in the Swamp

events.name: Wofford Terriers at Ole Miss Rebels

headlines.description: — Trinidad Chambliss threw for 367 yards and five touchdowns, and No. 25 Mississippi routed Wofford of the Football Championship Subdivision 59-17 Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trinidad Chambliss throws for 5 TDs and No. 25 Mississippi rolls past Wofford 59-17

events.name: Colorado Buffaloes at Cincinnati Bearcats

headlines.description: — Cole Tabb rushed for 120 yards and two touchdowns and also had seven catches for 110 yards and two TDs helping Cincinnati snap a three-game losing streak and become bowl eligible with a 35-28 victory over Colorado on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cincinnati snaps 3-game skid with 35-28 win over Colorado

events.name: Syracuse Orange at Boston College Eagles

headlines.description: — Mason McKenzie threw two touchdown passes, former Syracuse commit Bo MacCormack III broke up the middle for a 56-yard score and Boston College beat the Orange 27-15 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: McKenzie throws for 2 TDs and former Syracuse commit MacCormack helps lead BC over Orange 27-15

events.name: Northwestern Wildcats at Minnesota Golden Gophers

headlines.shortLinkText: Last-second field goal gives Minnesota 20-17 win over Northwestern to secure bowl eligibility

events.name: Wisconsin Badgers at Purdue Boilermakers

headlines.description: — Wisconsin quarterback Colton Joseph spent two weeks waiting for a chance to reclaim the starting job.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colton Joseph's return as starter comes with a flair as Wisconsin runs wild in 42-10 rout of Purdue

events.name: East Carolina Pirates at Army Black Knights

headlines.description: — Wide receiver Jason Dickerson threw a short scoring pass for the game's only touchdown and East Carolina defeated Army 10-6 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: East Carolina edges Army 10-6 on gadget-play touchdown pass by wide receiver Jason Dickerson

events.name: Memphis Tigers at Navy Midshipmen

headlines.description: — Vic Listorti ran for a 6-yard touchdown on fourth down with 15 seconds remaining, and Navy shook up the American Conference title race with a 38-34 win over No. 24 Memphis on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Navy scores with 15 seconds left, knocks off No. 24 Memphis 38-34 to shake up American Conf. race

events.name: North Texas Mean Green at Tulane Green Wave

events.name: North Carolina Tar Heels at Virginia Cavaliers

headlines.description: — Beau Pribula had his best passing game at Virginia, throwing for season-high 294 yards and four touchdowns, as the Cavaliers topped North Carolina 41-24 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pribula throws 4 TD passes, Virginia tops North Carolina 41-24 to get bowl eligible

events.name: Tennessee Tech Golden Eagles at Mississippi State Bulldogs

headlines.description: — Billy Puckett threw a pair of touchdown passes and Mississippi State’s offense looked as good as it has in months in the Bulldogs’ 34-16 win over Tennessee Tech on Saturday that snapped a six-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Puckett throws 2 TD passes and Mississippi State beats Tennessee Tech, ends 6-game losing streak

events.name: Western Kentucky Hilltoppers at Liberty Flames

headlines.description: — Deshawn Purdie threw for a season-high 344 yards and accounted for three touchdowns as No. 22 Liberty rolled past Western Kentucky 45-14 on Saturday for its 10th consecutive win.
headlines.shortLinkText: No. 22 Liberty beats Western Kentucky 45-14 for its 10th consecutive win

events.name: Charlotte 49ers at Tulsa Golden Hurricane

headlines.shortLinkText: Hayes throws 4 TD passes, Singleton catches 3 of them, and Tulsa routs Charlotte 42-14

events.name: Missouri State Bears at Jacksonville State Gamecocks

headlines.description: — Caden Creel threw two touchdown passes and added a 22-yard rushing TD in the final 13 minutes to help Jacksonville State overcome a 17-point fourth-quarter deficit and beat Missouri State 25-20 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Creel has 3 total TDs in 4th quarter, Jacksonville States beats Missouri State 25-20

events.name: Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders at Sam Houston Bearkats

headlines.description: — Terrence Brown ran 75 yards for a tiebreaking touchdown and Middle Tennessee beat Sam Houston 31-28 on Saturday to become bowl eligible for the first time...
headlines.shortLinkText: Brown's 75-yard rushing TD helps Middle Tennessee beat Sam Houston, become bowl eligible

events.name: South Florida Bulls at Florida Atlantic Owls

headlines.description: — Caden Veltkamp threw four touchdown passes and Florida Atlantic beat South Florida 35-14 on Saturday night in a game that endured multiple weather delays.
headlines.shortLinkText: Veltkamp throws 4 more TDs in Florida Atlantic's 35-14 win over South Florida

events.name: UL Monroe Warhawks at App State Mountaineers

headlines.shortLinkText: Aaron Clark blocks a PAT in overtime and Appalachian State edges UL Monroe 17-16

events.name: Coastal Carolina Chanticleers at Louisiana Ragin' Cajuns

headlines.description: — Lunch Winfield threw for three touchdowns and ran for another score to lead Louisiana-Lafayette to a 38-24 win over Coastal Carolina on Saturday for the Ragin' Cajuns third straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Winfield has 3 TD passes, runs for another score in Ragin' Cajuns' 38-24 win over Coastal Carolina

events.name: Delaware Blue Hens at New Mexico State Aggies

headlines.description: — Nick Minicucci threw three of his five touchdown passes to Scott Moore and broke Delaware's all-time passing touchdown record to help the Blue Hens beat New Mexico State 42-30 on Saturday to become bowl eligible.
headlines.shortLinkText: Minicucci throws for 5 TDs, breaks Delaware's career passing TD record in win over New Mexico St.

events.name: Florida International Panthers at Kennesaw State Owls

venue.fullName: Walens Family Field at Fifth Third Stadium

headlines.description: — Landon Varnes threw for 219 yards and two touchdowns and Kennesaw State beat Florida International 35-24 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Varnes, Woods fuel Kennesaw State offense in 35-24 win over Florida International

events.name: Samford Bulldogs at Auburn Tigers

headlines.description: — Tristan Ti'a threw for 341 yards and four touchdowns in the first half, added another touchdown on the ground and Auburn dominated Samford of the Championship Subdivision, 59-10 on Saturday.

events.name: NC State Wolfpack at Florida State Seminoles

headlines.description: — CJ Bailey threw for 292 yards and three touchdowns as NC State defeated Florida State 28-10 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: CJ Bailey, Davion Gause lead NC State to 28-10 win over Florida State

events.name: Rutgers Scarlet Knights at Penn State Nittany Lions

events.name: Old Dominion Monarchs at UConn Huskies

headlines.description: — Kalieb Osborne ran for a touchdown and threw for a score and UConn became bowl eligible with a 29-21 win over Old Dominion on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Osborne throws and runs for scores, UConn bowl eligible with 29-21 win over Old Dominion

events.name: Northern Illinois Huskies at North Dakota State Bison

events.name: Georgia Southern Eagles at Troy Trojans

headlines.shortLinkText: Max Johnson throws 3 TD passes in 1st half to help Georgia Southern thump Troy 45-7

events.name: Georgia State Panthers at Marshall Thundering Herd

headlines.description: — Carlos Del Rio-Wilson threw for 199 yards and three touchdowns and Marshall overcame a late rally to beat Georgia State 28-27 and become bowl eligible on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Del Rio-Wilson leads Marshall rally in 28-27 win over Georgia State to become bowl eligible

events.name: South Alabama Jaguars at Southern Miss Golden Eagles

headlines.shortLinkText: PJ Martin scores two 4th-quarter TDs and South Alabama rallies for 40-35 win over Southern Miss

events.name: Washington State Cougars at Texas State Bobcats

headlines.description: — Brad Jackson threw a touchdown pass and ran for three scores to lead Texas State to a 42-14 romp over Washington State on Saturday.

events.name: UNLV Rebels at San José State Spartans

events.name: Arkansas State Red Wolves at Louisiana Tech Bulldogs

events.name: Stanford Cardinal at California Golden Bears

events.name: Colorado State Rams at Fresno State Bulldogs

headlines.description: — Jayden Mandal threw for three touchdowns, Rayshon Luke had two rushing touchdowns and a receiving score, and Fresno State held off a late rally to beat Colorado State 49-42 on Saturday night.

events.name: UTSA Roadrunners at UAB Blazers

headlines.description: — Will Henderson III ran for 93 yards and A'Marion Peterson scored a touchdown and UTSA held on to beat UAB 19-17 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: UTSA holds off UAB 19-17 to maintain top spot in American Conference

events.name: Oklahoma State Cowboys at Arizona State Sun Devils

headlines.description: — Sam Keltner kicked a 35-yard field goal in overtime, Quinton Hammonds intercepted Jake Fette's first pass of the ensuing drive and Oklahoma State rallied from a 17-point halftime deficit to...

events.name: Utah State Aggies at Oregon State Beavers

headlines.shortLinkText: Jake Reichle runs for 3 TDs as Oregon State rallies past Utah State 31-24 to become bowl eligible

events.name: Hawai'i Rainbow Warriors at Nevada Wolf Pack

headlines.description: — AJ Bianco had a touchdown run and Jacob Fernandez kicked three field goals to lead Nevada to a 16-8 victory over Hawaii on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: AJ Bianco, Jacob Fernandez lead Nevada to 16-8 victory over Hawaii
